verdict.rationale: Fathom documents some fixed background automations: CRM field sync that updates records automatically after meetings (fathom-docs-12), automatic monitoring of key topics and keyword alerts (fathom-docs-18, fathom-docs-16), and AI summaries generated right after calls (fathom-docs-40). It also offers registrable webhooks that automatically push new meeting content to a chosen URL (fathom-docs-22, fathom-docs-45). These are set behaviors or developer triggers rather than a user-configurable automation or agent builder, so the story is only partly met. Missing for 10: a user-defined automation or workflow builder, autonomous multi-step agent actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
